div.div: 3 تايس قِرْنَهُ , (A,) inf. n. مُتَايَسَةٌ and تِيَاسٌ, (A, K,) (tropical:) He strove, struggled, contended, or conflicted, with his adversary; syn. مَارَسَهُ: (A:) [he strove with his adversary to repel him, like as a he-goat strives with another:] the inf. n. signifies the same as مُمَارَسَةٌ, and مُكَابَسَةٌ, and مُدَافَعَةٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
